profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Versant Media
profile.summary:
Professional Development/Trainings:

Computer Systems Life Cycle
Microsoft Visual Studio Trainings
Microsoft SQL Server Trainings
Oracle Trainings
ASP.NET Advanced Programming
Computer HW/SW Maintenance
Green Belt for Six Sigma Training


Skills:

Mathematical, statistical, analytical skills and computer literacy.

Deep and solid knowledge on SQL and/or PL/SQL Programming concepts on Oracle, MySQL and Microsoft SQL Server.

Expert in development of software applications using Microsoft Visual Studio 2010-2022 on the following software development modules: ASP.NET Web Forms (both on C# and Visual Basic), ASP.NET MVC (both using Razor or HTML), C++, Windows Forms and Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF).

Knowledge in the development of mobile applications for Android OS (both Native and Web Apps) using Java.

Knowledge in the development of mobile Web Applications for Apple iOS.

Solid skills for CCS3, HTML, HTML5, Javascript, jQuery, JsViews/JsRender, Foundation Framework and Endtest UI Automation.

Excellent skills for development of reports in Active Reports, Crystal Reports and Microsoft Reporting Services.

Basic to Solid skills on other programming platforms such as VueJs, TypeScript, WCF, AngularJS, Web API, Entity Framework and ODP.

Ability to follow written instruction and work under minimum supervision

Excellent organizational skills and ability to perform multiple tasks at once

Basic skills in Ethical Hacking and tools such as Wireshark, Nmap, Backtrack.

Basic skills in Perl and Solid Skill in C, C++, VB6.

Basic skills in Tableau and Lavastorm

Solid skills in data entry, Microsoft Office, Outlook, Windows, Linux.

Fluent in Spanish and English.

Work well under pressure.

Strong communicator.

Team player.

Tinker at heart.

positions.title: Senior Web Engineer
positions.description:
- Currently the Senior Web Engineer and lead of the GolfNow/TeeOff Front-End team for NBC Sports Next.

- Worked on all GolfNow products and lead the GolfNow Front-End team to update, maintain and implement new features on all GolfNow websites (US/AU/UK/EU/TeeOff).

- Handled communication across multiple teams within (e.g.: Back-end, Mobile, Front-End, GolfPass) and outside (e.g.: OneTrust, LetzChat) our organization, and work together with these teams to implement new features on GolfNow.

- Added automation (using EndTest.io) to our QA regression process.

- Improved the GolfPass promotion mechanism on our Checkout page by having a more flexible and customizable interstitials and side cart in which resulted in an increase of GolfPass members
  
- Created shared code/components that can be consumed by our mobile app teams inside their Web Views.

- Being part of the GolfNow deployments in order to assist the DevOps team with any issues that may occur. Monitored the deployments health using tools such as AppDynamics and DataDog.
  
- Created documentation using Confluence

- Meet with different teams before, during and after new implementations in order to keep communication flowing and make sure requirements are being complied.

- Provide new web design ideas for improving quality and performance.

- Performed maintenance and operation tasks through debugging code to find and fix bugs.

- Used JsRender/JsViews and CSHTML to create widgets and templates that can be re-used across the site.

- Provide mentorship to junior developers and interviewed new candidates.

- Work on the conversion of our Websites from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 8

- Software and tools used: ASP.NET MVC, C#, HTML5, JavaScript, VueJs, jQuery, TypeScript, JsRender/JsViews, CSS, JSON, Foundation Framework, Ajax, CrateDB, and Distributed Caching systems like Redis, Akamai (CDN), Visual Studio 2022, VS Code, MacOS & Windows, GitHub, DataDog, AppDynamics, Confluence, Jira

company.name: GolfNow, a division of Golf Channel

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Front-End development for TAG’s Data Analytics web application (http://sportsbar.ea.com). 

- Redesigned web authorization security model for executive business users.

- Designed new database meta mapping tables to support new web reporting templates.

- Developed new administration pages for managing new meta mapping tables and new authorization security model.

- Redesigned and developed new dynamic navigation menu with security model for all application pages.

- Chart development using highchart.js.

- JavaScript development using jQuery, knockout.js and Telerik’s Kendo UI Web Controls.

- Used bootstrap for adding new modal popup responsive design in pages.

- Designed and developed several new custom franchise templates using CSS3 and HTML5.

- Owned server configuration and deployment for web application using IIS Windows Server 2008 and 2012.

- Support team members with development tasks.

- Performed maintenance and operation tasks through debugging code to find and fix bugs.

- Create documentation using Confluence.

- Analyze and create design for new pages.

- Provide new web design ideas for improving quality and performance.

- Worked with Hansoft to manage two-week Sprints in Agile Methodology, Code Collaborator and Perforce for code reviews and source code management. Part of agile scrum meetings.

- T-SQL development for database objects such as stored procedures, basic queries and functions to support web development.

- Created dynamic dashboards for analyzing franchises monetization data using Tableau.

- Created automation processes for weekly reports (NBA Live, Madden, UFC, etc.) using Lavastorm.

- Software and Tools Used: C#, HTML5, JavaScript, jQuery, Highcharts, ASP.NET Webforms, JSON, T-SQL with SQL Server 2012, Visual Studio 2010, Bootstrap, CSS3, Telerik’s Kendo UI Web Controls, ADO.Net, Ajax, Hansoft, Confluence, Perforce, and Code Collaborator.

positions.title: Solutions Engineer
positions.description:
- Front-End development using .NET Framework 4.5 and Visual Studio 2013.

- Handle multiple clients and multiple team members.

- Analyze and design web applications.

- Provide mentorship to junior developers.

- Part of agile scrum meetings and work using the SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle).

- Software and Tools Used: C#, HTML5, JavaScript, jQuery, JqGrid, JSON, MVC5, SQL Server 2012, Bootstrap, CSS3 and T-SQL, Tortoise svn, Sharepoint, Mongodb, Telerik’s Kendo UI Web Controls, Google API, ADO.Net, and Ajax.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Web application development using .NET Framework 4.5 and Visual Studio 2013.

- Manage projects under an SQL Server 2012 Backend and develop database objects such as 
Stored Procedures, basic queries and Functions.

- Create Technical Design Documents used for the applications development and testing.

- Part of agile scrum meetings and work using the SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle).

- Developed new products using the following programming languages and tools: VB.Net, C#, HTML5, Javascript, Jquery, Jqgrid, MVC, SQL Server 2012, Accurev, Akcelerant Framework, CSS3 and T-SQL.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Provide support to the United States Department of Defense projects.

- Member of a cross-functional development team - ETS (Engineer Testing Services) team.

- Manage requirements, design, code, test, and integrate real-time embedded software for Inertial  Navigation Systems with an embedded Global Positioning System receiver.

- Resolve software discrepancies.

- Generate required software documentation (Qualification Test Procedure, Software Engineering Document, Software Design Document, Acceptance Test Procedure, Interface Control Document, and Software Requirement Specifications).

- Responsible for managing schedule and budgeted hours for specific tasks assigned.
Create and/or modify source code for programs to test hardware specs (VB6, C++, Foxpro, Access).

positions.title: Software Developer, Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
- Responsible of the development and maintenance of web-based applications such as ISOtrain Web 6, iKAT, iEnroll, iRoster, iConnect, iDoc, iHR, iTrain, iReport and iMail.

- Develop all software applications under the Microsoft ASP.NET Web Forms and ASP.NET MVC structures using C# and Visual Basic language.

- Provide input in multiple application designs for the different projects assigned.

- Provide support in the development of multiple database-centric programs, such as Stored Procedures, Triggers, Views and Oracle Packages.

- Develop applications using third-party programming tools and control toolkits such as Telerik, KendoUI, JavaScript and AJAX.

- Develop reports using Active Reports.

- Support software customers related to QA, IT and product problems or questions

- Provide support in the administration of all Oracle databases used for development activities at Softek Export.
Serve as main Softek Export liaison in the 2013 Visual Studio Live Conference in Orlando, Florida.

- Served as a Quality Assurance Specialist during a 3-month period in which I was in charge of executing an Installation Qualification (IQ) Protocol, executing an Operational Qualification (OQ) Protocol and developing a Traceability Matrix related to the iDoc product.

- Execute other tasks as required by the team.

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description:
- Implement an interconnection between multiple databases from different federal agencies in order to share their information between each other to help finding people of interest (criminals). Bayesian networks. Programming in C++ and Perl.

- Data Mining – Analyze big sets of data in order to extract unknown patterns and use them for prediction using Bayesian networks.

- Studied and programmed Bayesian Networks in order to predict events and disease.

- Create Web Crawler using Perl in order to obtain pictures from FBI Most Wanted people websites.

positions.title: Math tutor
positions.description: Help students to understand the class material and teach them an organized and structured way of studying algebra, pre-calculus and calculus.

company.name: Pa' los duros: School specialized in Science & Mathematics

positions.title: Karate Instructor
positions.description:
- Teach Shotokan Karate to children and adults. 

- Self-defense seminars

- More than 16 years of experience. 

- Rank - Black Belt, Nidan (2nd Dan)

- Trained at JKA HQ in Japan. 

- Trained at Miami Shotokan with sensei Jose Ferrand (JKA 6th Dan).

- ISKF Master Camp 40 Anniversary goodwill tournament black belt Kumite champion (1st place), black belt Team Kata and black belt Team Kumite (3rd place). 

- Teach on Escuela de los Deportes in Carolina, PR

- Throughout my Karate journey I had the chance to train with great Shotokan karate instructors such as Ozaka, Shimizu, Oshi, Okazaki, Shiina, Kobayashi, etc.
